fact: In March 2022 the DGSN was seeking a consultant, through a tender published in Cameroon Tribune, to build a digital platform and software for automated management of data from users' complaints in general and complaints against the police in particular, with technical and financial support from German cooperation; for the time being complaints were handled through a switchboard on the number 1500.
title: Le Cameroun veut mettre en place une plateforme numérique pour traiter les plaintes des usagers contre la police
